data.title: A Day at the Beach
data.draft: I went to the beach. I built a huge sandcastle. The waves washed it away. We ate cold ice cream. The sun was very hot.

targets.originalText: I went to the beach. I built a huge sandcastle.
targets.suggestion: These two short sentences tell what you did first. Can you use the word 'and' or 'when' to combine them into one smooth sentence?
targets.idealRevision: When I went to the beach, I built a huge sandcastle.

targets.originalText: We ate cold ice cream. The sun was very hot.
targets.suggestion: These sentences describe two things happening on the same trip. Try using the word 'because' to show why you ate the cold ice cream.
targets.idealRevision: We ate cold ice cream because the sun was very hot.
